rule: On one bullet hit: (1) type.hit runs first: impact effect, click with random pitch, camera shake, then frags, puddles, fire, unit spawns, suppression; (2) the bullet is removed unless it pierces; (3) type.hitEntity applies damage, then knockback impulse divided by mass (size squared times pi), then status chance and the damage event. Flash: damage sets hitTime to 1, decaying by 1/9 per tick to show the white mix. Damage over time re-flashes only once hitTime is at -1 or lower (18 ticks), otherwise it restores the old value. Shake: intensity and duration are each max-merged, capped at 100, decay linearly, and are applied as a random offset scaled by the player setting; a distance falloff applies in world units.

data_fields.name: hit_shake_intensity
data_fields.unit: px per hit, per bullet type

data_fields.name: knockback_mass_rule
data_fields.unit: mass from size squared times pi

keep: Max-merge shake with a cap, not a sum, so three hits in one tick give one shake
Damage-over-time flash gate, so a continuous hazard does not flash every frame
Mass-scaled knockback with a per-unit immunity multiplier
Per-bullet hit effect field, so each weapon has its own burst
Random pitch on the click, so repeated hits do not sound identical
change: Fire the visual, click and shake from the server-confirmed hit event, not before damage (donor order is a defect for a server-verified game)
Divide shake falloff distance by camera zoom, so zoom does not change the feel
Flash as a rim on the creature outline, not a full mix, for readability at 375 wide
Own burst strokes and palette; no donor sprite or sound
look_test: Build one grey creature with a one-pixel rim and three attackers that can hit it in the same tick. Show four variants at 375 wide: A donor order (burst, click, 9-tick white flash, max-merge shake); B shake off; C flash gated to one per window; D rim flash instead of full white. Dom judges which hit landed and whether the triple hit reads as one moment or noise. Control: a two-frame hit-stop (not donor-backed). Target src/fight/hit-feedback.ts, parity row 10.
